name: Rogo
summary: Rogo builds an agentic AI platform for financial-services professionals. It raised $160 million in an April 2026 Series D at a reported $2 billion valuation.
overview: Rogo provides AI tools for financial institutions and professionals, targeting research, analysis and workflow automation. The company is competing for adoption in a high-value, tightly regulated enterprise market.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Rogo raised $160 million in Series D funding at a reported $2 billion valuation.

bull_case: Financial workflows offer high willingness to pay if Rogo delivers accuracy, security and deep integration with institutional processes.
bear_case: Financial AI faces rigorous data, compliance and reliability requirements, while larger model and software vendors compete for the same budgets.
latest_round: April 2026 Series D: $160M at a reported $2B valuation
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Rogo builds an agentic AI platform for financial-services professionals, supporting research, analysis, and workflow automation.
company: Rogo develops an agentic AI platform for financial-services professionals, aimed at research, analysis and other high-value institutional workflows. Its opportunity depends on delivering useful automation within strict data and compliance constraints.
The company announced a $160 million Series D in April 2026 to scale the platform. A $2 billion valuation was reported alongside the financing and is labelled as reported context in this profile.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Rogo is a direct private-market test of whether vertical AI can earn durable financial-institution budgets. Enterprise retention, accuracy and secure deployment are more meaningful indicators than its reported valuation alone.

takeaways: Rogo targets AI workflows for financial-services professionals.
The $160M Series D is company-announced; the $2B valuation is reported context.
